_comment: Demo video only: a fictional active subscription that makes Bob premium, so the leaderboard shows no Upgrade to Premium banner (Vue shows it when the profile has no subscription; the Hub returns the user's active subscriptions row). Not part of the screenshot fixtures (db-reset asserts there are no subscriptions, and the approved leaderboard screenshots show the banner): video.mjs inserts this row after claiming the fixtures and its restore deletes it. The Stripe fields are required columns and are fictional placeholders; nothing contacts Stripe and the Hub does not return them to the app.
